name: simpleecode
description: SimpleeCode is a local VS Code extension that explains your codebase in plain language, grounded in your actual code.

enumDescriptions: Use the spawned ACP agent when its command is on PATH; otherwise fall back to the vscode-acp extension commands.
Always spawn the ACP agent process (real delivery; answers stream into the dashboard).
Always use the vscode-acp extension commands (clipboard safety net).
simpleecode.acp.transport.description: How SimpleeCode talks to Claude Code.

simpleecode.acp.agentCommand.markdownDescription: Command that starts the ACP agent process. Default is `claude-code-acp` (`npm i -g @zed-industries/claude-code-acp`).

simpleecode.acp.agentArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the ACP agent command.

simpleecode.acp.environmentVariables.markdownDescription: Additional environment variable names to pass to the ACP agent. SimpleeCode passes only a minimal non-secret environment by default; add a name here only when the agent explicitly requires it.

simpleecode.acp.extensionId.markdownDescription: Extension id of the installed ACP / Claude Code transport extension (`vscode-acp`). Used for availability detection and the install hint. The marketplace build of `formulahendry/vscode-acp` is `formulahendry.acp-client`; the Open VSX build is `omercnet.vscode-acp`.

simpleecode.acp.commands.openChat.description: Command id used to open the ACP chat panel.

simpleecode.acp.commands.sendPrompt.description: Command id used to send a prompt to the ACP agent.

simpleecode.acp.commands.newConversation.description: Command id used to start a new ACP conversation.

enumDescriptions: Try to pass the prompt to the ACP send command; if that is not supported, fall back to copying the prompt to the clipboard and opening the chat panel.
Only call the ACP send command (best when the command accepts a prompt argument).
Always copy the prompt to the clipboard and open the chat panel for manual paste.
simpleecode.acp.sendStrategy.description: How SimpleeCode hands a built prompt to the ACP transport.

simpleecode.updates.checkOnStartup.description: Opt in to an HTTPS update check when the window opens. Off by default to preserve local-first startup.

simpleecode.updates.source.markdownDescription: Where the latest version lives: an https URL to a `latest.json` (`{version, url, sha256, notes}`) or a repo `package.json`. Automatic VSIX installation requires a same-origin HTTPS URL and matching SHA-256. Empty disables the check.

simpleecode.updates.updateCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command run in a terminal when you click **Update now** (e.g. pull the repo, `npm run compile`, package and install the `.vsix`). Empty shows manual instructions instead.

simpleecode.feedback.endpoint.markdownDescription: URL of the SimpleeCode feedback function (e.g. `https://<site>.netlify.app/.netlify/functions/feedback`). Set by the beta owner. Feedback you send goes only here.

simpleecode.feedback.token.markdownDescription: Shared secret that authorizes sending feedback (must match the server's `FEEDBACK_TOKEN`). Provided by the beta owner.

simpleecode.feedback.tester.description: Your name or handle, attached to feedback you send so the team knows who reported it. Leave empty to stay anonymous.

simpleecode.privacy.defaultScope.description: Maximum context SimpleeCode may include. Explicit selection and file commands stay narrower; broader system-role work is capped here.

simpleecode.privacy.showPromptBeforeSend.description: Show a confirmation preview of exactly what will be sent to Claude before sending.

simpleecode.privacy.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes of file content included in a packet. Larger files are truncated with a marker.

simpleecode.privacy.redactSecrets.description: Redact lines that look like secrets (api keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) before sending.

simpleecode.privacy.blockedFileGlobs.description: Files matching these globs are never sent to Claude.

simpleecode.retrieval.enableSparseSearch.description: Roadmap gate for deterministic sparse search across indexed summaries and symbols. Off by default; direct imports, declarations, and tests still retrieve under related-files scopes.
